messages:
sara: quick Q — users seeing truncated/partial streaming responses in prod. Where do we look for per-connection chunk timings, sample packet loss, and kv-cache hits? need links/quick queries.

mike: start with Grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/streaming-overview?panelId=9 — panel shows per-node chunk_latency_p50/p95 and packet_loss_rate. For connection-level traces use: https://traces.redwood.internal/trace?service=streaming&query={{conn_id}} (you can paste conn_id from logs).

sara: thanks. where are the logs? I only see aggregated logs in Loki.

mike: logs are in Loki. Quick query to find disconnects and partial frames:
```
{job="streamer"} |= "partial_frame" | json | conn_id, shard, token_count
```
That'll give conn_id to link into traces/dash.

sophia: tagging infra — we recently added trace sampling to avoid flood. obs-bot counts ~1% sampling for full traces. If you need full traces, add `trace: full` header for a short window.

obs-bot: Note: current trace_sampling=1%. Alert `stream.partial_rate` threshold=0.8% (5m).

mike: proposal: temporarily bump alert to 1.5% for the next 24h while we collect samples and tune. I've spun up an ad-hoc dashboard with per-region buckets: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/streaming-ad-hoc?orgId=1

sara: +1 — can you also add a panel for per-connection chunk-size distribution? that's likely the root cause.

mike: added panel, and a small histogram for chunk_size by conn_id. Also started a capture to save 500 recent `partial_frame` logs with full traces — uploaded to the jump host at `/tmp/stream-partials-1860001234.json` (ssh jumpbox-prod).

sophia: FYI I'll open a PR to adjust query-level sampling and add a short note in the streaming runbook about correlating `kv_cache_hit` with partials.

sara: perfect, thanks both. If we see >2% partial_rate after sampling change we escalate to SRE.

mike: noted. ping me if you want a few example trace links — I can paste a couple here. :white_check_mark:
